# Nila

Nila gives farmers in Tamil Nadu, India, a year plan for every field and the money and services to carry it out, through their own unions (self-help groups and farmer producer organisations, about 2,000 members). A crop advance pays for a planned crop and is paid back from its harvest; the cash part comes from the union members' own savings, services (machine work by the acre, seed, storage) come as vouchers. Each planned crop is a standing-crop record tied to the farmer's land title. Records and crop advances are on Polygon (first seasons) and Stellar (since 6 November 2026).

nUSD is a dollar position on Stellar, still in development: the dollars guarantee the vouchers, the return is the interest on them. Target 3–5% a year, not guaranteed.

Words: "crop advance" (on-chain and in the audit: loan), "standing-crop record" (on-chain: FoodToken).

## Audit

- [Audit fact sheet](https://nila.land/audit/facts.md): every verifiable claim with its on-chain source, read calls and open items. Ask your LLM to refute it.
- [Snapshot](https://nila.land/audit/snapshot.json): every value read from the chains, per crop advance, with block and ledger.
- [Audit page](https://nila.land/audit): the fact sheet for people.
